ov: أساطير الخريف (بالإنجليزية:Legends of the Fall) فيلم درامي تاريخي أمريكي ملحمي أنتج عام 1994 من إخراج إدوارد زويك وبطولة براد بيت وأنتوني هوبكنز وأيدان كوين وجوليا أورموند وهنري توماس. أخذت قصة الفيلم من رواية صدرت عام 1979 وتحمل نفس العنوان لجيم هاريسون . تحكي قصة الفيلم عن ثلاثة أشقاء ووالدهم يعيشون في برية وسهول ولاية مونتانا في أوائل القرن العشرين وكيف تتأثر حياتهم بالطبيعة والتاريخ والحرب والحب . يمتد الإطار الزمني للفيلم من أوائل القرن العشرين ، والحرب العالمية الأولى وانتهى بمشهد قصير في عام 1963. تم ترشيح الفيلم لثلاث جوائز أكاديمية وفاز بجائزة أفضل تصوير سينمائي .
plotEn:
Colonel William Ludlow retires from the Army to a remote part of Montana, sick of betrayals the US government perpetrated on Native Americans. He builds a ranch with One Stab and raises his family. Working the ranch are hired hand and former outlaw Decker with his Cree wife Pet, and daughter Isabel Two. William's wife Isabel does not adapt to the harsh Montana winters and moves to the East Coast. Tristan, the middle of the family's three sons, vows never to speak of her. At age 12, Tristan touches a sleeping grizzly bear, which awakens and injures him, but he cuts off a claw.
Years later Samuel, the youngest son, returns from Harvard University with his fiancée, Susannah. Before they can marry, Samuel announces his intention to join the Canadian Expeditionary Force and aid Britain in the fight against Germany in World War I. To William's displeasure, the eldest son Alfred also joins. Tristan reluctantly joins after swearing to Susannah to protect Samuel. 
The brothers go to France with the 10th Battalion, CEF. Alfred, commissioned as an officer, is wounded in a failed frontal assault against enemy trenches. Samuel and Tristan survive the battle. While visiting Alfred in the field hospital, Tristan learns Samuel volunteered for a dangerous reconnaissance mission. He rushes to find his brother, who is wounded in no man's land and dies in Tristan's arms. Tristan cuts his brother's heart out and sends it home to be buried at the ranch.
